premium_keys.title: Premium Key Authorization Record
premium_keys.description: Stores activation, device binding, and administrative authorization status for individual premium files.

key.description: The exact unique premium authorization key from GitHub Gist

firebaseUid.description: Firebase User UID or client session identifier bound to this key

browserId.description: Persistent browser/device identity token stored in LocalStorage

createdAt.description: Timestamp when key was first registered in Firebase

boundAt.description: Timestamp when key was bound to device

lastUsedAt.description: Timestamp of most recent authorized download
